Vitalik Proposes Recursive STARK Mempools for Ethereum’s Future I-Star Upgrade

Vitalik Buterin has proposed EIP-8288, a recursive STARK mempool design that he hopes will be included in Ethereum’s I-Star upgrade, following Hegota.

The proposal aggregates transaction dependencies in the mempool and generates recursive STARK proofs. It aims to reduce the cost of quantum-safe signatures and privacy transactions, support new signature or proof schemes such as Falcon and ML-DSA without requiring EVM changes, and enable private account abstraction. — link

Consensys Software to Split into MetaMask and Consensys as Independent Companies

Consensys Software Inc. will split into two independently operated companies. MetaMask will focus on its consumer platform, with Joseph Lubin serving as chairman and CEO.

A newly formed Consensys will retain the protocols and institutional infrastructure businesses, including Linea, with Lubin as executive chairman. MetaMask says users’ apps, assets, keys and access will remain unchanged. The wallet has more than 100 million downloads across roughly 190 countries. — link

Plume Launches FACTOR Vault Offering Direct Exposure to Invoice Factoring and Working Capital Facilities

Plume has launched FACTOR, a limited-capacity vault developed in partnership with Tradeable and Deep Ocean Partners. The product directly invests in a curated and actively managed portfolio of invoice factoring and working capital facilities underwritten in partnership with the lender of record, without an intermediary issuer. It offers weekly liquidity and targets a net APY of 14% or more.

Osmosis: Nomic Chain Suffers nBTC Double-Spend Exploit; 22.65 BTC Frozen in Attacker’s Address

Osmosis said an exploit on the Nomic chain allowed an attacker to double-spend nBTC and send fake vouchers to Osmosis. Osmosis and IBC were not compromised.

39.84 nBTC, representing about 36% of Alloyed BTC’s backing, is affected. Osmosis has paused inflows and outflows, while an emergency upgrade froze 22.65 BTC in the attacker’s address.

Osmosis plans to seek governance approval to seize the frozen assets and use BTC from the community pool to restore full backing. — link
